description: This file contains the implementation of an immutable class 'ImmutablePolicyEntry' which implements the 'PolicyEntry' interface. It provides methods for creating policy entries, including from JSON, and overrides methods like equals, hashCode, and toString.

classes.name: ImmutablePolicyEntry
classes.description: An immutable implementation of the PolicyEntry interface, representing a policy entry with label, subjects, and resources.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new PolicyEntry with specified label, subjects, and resources.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a PolicyEntry from a JSON object, extracting subjects and resources.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Returns the label of the policy entry.

methods.name: getSubjects
methods.description: Returns the subjects of the policy entry.

methods.name: getResources
methods.description: Returns the resources of the policy entry.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the policy entry to a JSON object with schema version and predicate filtering.
